# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 49 (Bu-Vb Pc49)

**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc49
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 49
**Title (English, from literature):** Staying more than three days with an army
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 49, entitled *Senāvāsa*, is a disciplinary rule in the Vinaya Piṭaka regulating a monk's presence in a military encampment. According to the rule, a monk who stays with an army for more than three nights commits an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*). An English translation of the text has been made by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
